title: /healthz no longer touches Postgres, so a replica with a permanently broken database stays Ready
notes: The probe was changed to return 204 with no database check, as the task asks. A replica whose database is permanently unreachable (bad credentials after a rotation, a wrong host) stays in service, and every request on it then waits in db.Retry with no upper bound except the client giving up. A cap on the wait, or a separate readiness signal such as 'away longer than N minutes', would be cheap. Promoted to JS-056.
